# upwind_threat_policy (Resource)

Manages an Upwind threat policy: a named detection rule container with a severity, a telemetry source, and an optional resource scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A policy applies to the whole organization when resource_scope is omitted.
# This is the usual case: an organization with many cloud accounts does not
# want a policy per account.
resource "upwind_threat_policy" "org_wide" {
  name        = "CloudTrail privilege escalation"
  severity    = "high"
  source_type = "cloud_logs"

  metadata = {
    detection_title       = "Privilege Escalation Attempt"
    detection_description = "IAM changes that grant broad permissions"
  }
}

# Scope it when a policy should only cover part of the estate. Prefer the
# organization or OU condition types over listing individual accounts: they do
# not go stale as accounts are added and removed.
resource "upwind_threat_policy" "production_only" {
  name        = "CloudTrail privilege escalation (production)"
  severity    = "critical"
  source_type = "cloud_logs"
  is_enabled  = true

  metadata = {
    detection_title       = "Privilege Escalation Attempt"
    detection_description = "IAM changes that grant broad permissions in production"
  }

  resource_scope = {
    condition = {
      type     = "cloud_account_ou_rule"
      field    = "cloud_account_ou_id"
      operator = "in"
      value    = ["ou-1234-abcdefgh"]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metadata` (Attributes) Display metadata shown on detections raised by this policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `name` (String) Policy name.
- `severity` (String) Severity of detections raised by this policy. One of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical`. Sent to the API as `default_severity`, returned as `severity`.
- `source_type` (String) Telemetry source this policy evaluates. One of `cloud_logs`, `sensor`, `k8s_audit_logs`. Immutable: changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether this policy is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `resource_scope` (Attributes) Limits which cloud resources this policy applies to. Omit to apply it everywhere. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_scope))

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) ISO8601 timestamp when the policy was created.
- `creator_id` (String) ID of the user or client that created this policy.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this policy (server-generated). Maps to the API's `policy_id`.
- `last_modifier_id` (String) ID of the user or client that last modified this policy.
- `update_time` (String) ISO8601 timestamp when the policy was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Required:

- `detection_description` (String) Description shown on a detection.
- `detection_title` (String) Title shown on a detection, e.g. `Privilege Escalation Attempt`.


<a id="nestedatt--resource_scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource_scope`

Optional:

- `condition` (Attributes) A single scope-matching rule. Omit for no scope. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_scope--condition))

<a id="nestedatt--resource_scope--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource_scope.condition`

Required:

- `field` (String) Field to match against.
- `operator` (String) Match operator. One of `equals`, `not_equals`, `in`, `not_in`.
- `type` (String) Condition type: `cloud_account_rule`, `cloud_account_ou_rule`, `cloud_account_organization_rule`, or `cluster_id_rule`. The spec also lists `cloud_provider_rule`, but the API rejects it for policy scopes with "condition type(s) not allowed". The composite `filter` type is not supported.
- `value` (Set of String) Values to match against. Unordered (a set).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Threat policies import by their server-generated policy id.
terraform import upwind_threat_policy.org_wide cp-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
